object: The atomic unit of Hoard.  A card is a single org-mode file with a UUID, a type, and structured sections (Relations, Scope Note, Notes, References).  Each card represents one entity — a person, concept, event, work, organization, or system — and compiles to a set of quads that capture its relationships.
